raw_plan.root_cause: The function computes the input string length with compiler_rt.strlen, adds 1, and passes that unbounded length to compiler_rt.memcpy.memcpyFast with a fixed 16-byte stack destination at [rbp-0x20], so inputs longer than 15 bytes overflow the destination and adjacent stack memory.
raw_plan.original_behavior: Reads the input pointer argument, computes strlen(input), copies strlen(input)+1 bytes from input into the 16-byte stack buffer at [rbp-0x20], then calls puts on that buffer and returns after verifying the stack canary.
raw_plan.required_invariant: At most 15 bytes of input plus a NUL terminator may be written into the 16-byte destination buffer; the copy length must never exceed capacity-1 plus NUL.
raw_plan.repair_strategy: Compute the input length with compiler_rt.strlen, compare it against the 15-byte maximum, and if it exceeds the limit skip the copy and puts (return without writing) or otherwise reject; for inputs that fit, copy length+1 bytes into the 16-byte buffer and call puts, preserving the stack canary check and normal return path.
raw_plan.failure_behavior: For inputs whose length exceeds 15 bytes, do not perform the copy or puts; return normally without modifying the destination buffer beyond its capacity, preserving the stack canary and calling convention.
raw_plan.expected_behavior: For inputs of length 0 through 15, copy the string plus NUL into the 16-byte buffer and print it with puts, matching original observable behavior; for longer inputs, reject by returning without copying or printing, never writing more than 16 bytes to the destination.
verification_conditions: Inputs of length 0-15 produce identical output to the original function
Inputs of length 16 or greater do not overflow the 16-byte destination and return without corrupting the stack canary
Only direct calls to 0x109e050, 0x109ed10, and 0x108a31c are emitted
Function terminates with ret and preserves x86_64 SysV calling convention
Stack canary check at [rbp-8] remains intact

note: baseline is deterministic; AI target assembly is accepted only by native/qemu PoC+regression. baseline_target_strict calls repair_any(target=<case target>, require_target=True) and records the resolved target_scope plus target_in_scope (every produced action inside the target; empty action lists are not in scope). baseline_target_aware receives the same target/capacity hint; ai_blind uses the public AI path without target. allow_calls only permits direct calls already present in the target function.
evaluation_note: deterministic baselines run on the host; PoC evaluation and the unstripped x86-64 target execution run in the Linux guest (Lima) via the poc/guest runner. Provider prompts/responses are never stored.
